brief: Deploy the already-reviewed Nicholas AI Switchboard from services/ai-switchboard through the existing Mac and Cloudflare environment. Reuse the OpenRouter credential already stored locally by OpenCode without printing or committing it. Generate/store the GPT Action bearer key only in macOS Keychain and Cloudflare Worker secrets. Install the local ai launcher, resolve the live Ox/GLM and Qwen3.8 model IDs, perform health/model checks and the tiny Ox end-to-end switchboard test, and report only non-secret deployment metadata. Preserve all existing models and services.
